stories.title: Recipe: Chimichurri rojo (red chimichurri)
stories.summary: Chimichurri Rojo is a red-pepper take on the classic Argentinian herb sauce. Smoky paprika, roasted red pepper, garlic and fresh herbs all contribute to a wonderful taste.

stories.title: Draisaitl powers Oilers past Canucks
stories.summary: Leon Draisaitl had two goals and an assist and Connor McDavid added three assists as the Edmonton Oilers came away with a 4-2 victory over the struggling Vancouver Canucks on Saturday.

stories.title: WATCH: Global News Hour at 6 BC: Nov. 7
stories.summary: Watch the online edition of Global News Hour at 6 BC.

stories.title: Captured bear undergoes DNA testing to determine involvement in deadly attack
stories.summary: The BC Conservation Officer Service said any bears involved in the attack will be killed to protect public safety. Unrelated bears will be released.

stories.title: First of season storms bring ‘minor’ flooding, outages to B.C.
stories.summary: As storms continue across B.C., authorities are warning about high winds bringing more power outages and the dangers of rising water levels.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions Canadian firms connected to Ryan Wedding and Iran
stories.summary: The department says it sanctioned money services businesses in British Columbia and Ontario in co-ordination with Fintrac, Canada's anti-money laundering watchdog.

stories.summary: Watch the online news edition of Global Okanagan at 5:30 p.m.

stories.title: Second penalty against X denied for not deleting intimate images, B.C. tribunal rules
stories.summary: Last year, the B.C. Tribunal ruled that X must pay a $100,000 penalty for not deleting an intimate image after a protection order was issued.

stories.title: Relaxing foreign buyer ban would benefit B.C. housing market, expert says
stories.summary: The foreign homebuyers ban was launched on Jan. 1, 2023, when the Bank of Canada was aggressively raising interest rates and as other global economic factors weighed on homebuyers.

stories.title: Fall storm forces evacuation order in small B.C. community
stories.summary: A yellow rainfall warning is in effect on Friday for areas including the North Shore, Coquitlam, Maple Ridge and Howe Sound. More rain is expected.
